title: Error v1 (RFC 7807)
description: Problem Details for HTTP APIs (RFC 7807). Every non-2xx response uses this shape with Content-Type application/problem+json. Never leaks stack traces or secrets (TRD §11, §20).

type.description: A URI reference identifying the problem type. Dereferenceable to human docs. 'about:blank' when there is no specific type.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem type. Stable for a given `type`.

status.description: HTTP status code, duplicated here for convenience.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence. Safe to show a developer; contains no secrets.
examples: The provided X-Signature did not match the computed HMAC over the canonical payload.

instance.description: URI reference identifying this specific occurrence (e.g. a request id path).

code.description: Extension: stable machine-readable error code for SDKs to switch on (independent of prose).

errors.description: Extension: field-level validation problems, present when code = validation_failed.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer to the offending field in the request body.

detail.description: What is wrong with that field.
